+// IsSegment is the value of a rule's segment field.
+type IsSegment interface{ isSegment() }
+
+type SegmentKey string
+
+func (SegmentKey) isSegment() {}
+
+type Segments struct {
+	Keys            []string `yaml:"keys"`
+	SegmentOperator string   `yaml:"operator"`
+}
+
+func (Segments) isSegment() {}
+
+type SegmentEmbed struct{ Segment IsSegment }
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) MarshalYAML() (interface{}, error) {
+	if s == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing rule segment")
+	}
+	switch v := s.Segment.(type) {
+	case SegmentKey:
+		if v == "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty rule segment")
+		}
+		return string(v), nil
+	case Segments:
+		_, operator, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		v.SegmentOperator = operator
+		return v, nil
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid rule segment type %T", s.Segment)
+	}
+}
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) UnmarshalYAML(unmarshal func(interface{}) error) error {
+	var raw interface{}
+	if err := unmarshal(&raw); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	switch v := raw.(type) {
+	case string:
+		if v == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("empty rule segment")
+		}
+		s.Segment = SegmentKey(v)
+	case map[interface{}]interface{}:
+		return s.unmarshalSegments(v)
+	case map[string]interface{}:
+		fields := make(map[interface{}]interface{}, len(v))
+		for key, value := range v {
+			fields[key] = value
+		}
+		return s.unmarshalSegments(fields)
+	default:
+		return fmt.Errorf("rule segment must be a string or keys/operator object")
+	}
+	_, _, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+	return err
+}
+
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) unmarshalSegments(fields map[interface{}]interface{}) error {
+	var group Segments
+	for key, value := range fields {
+		switch key {
+		case "keys":
+			items, ok := value.([]interface{})
+			if !ok {
+				return fmt.Errorf("segment keys must be a list")
+			}
+			for _, item := range items {
+				name, ok := item.(string)
+				if !ok || name == "" {
+					return fmt.Errorf("segment keys must contain nonempty strings")
+				}
+				group.Keys = append(group.Keys, name)
+			}
+		case "operator":
+			operator, ok := value.(string)
+			if ok {
+				group.SegmentOperator = operator
+			}
+		default:
+			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported segment field %v", key)
+		}
+	}
+	s.Segment = group
+	_, operator, err := s.KeysAndOperator()
+	if err == nil {
+		group.SegmentOperator = operator
+		s.Segment = group
+	}
+	return err
+}
+
+// KeysAndOperator validates and normalizes either representation.
+func (s *SegmentEmbed) KeysAndOperator() ([]string, string, error) {
+	if s == nil {
+		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("missing rule segment")
+	}
+	switch v := s.Segment.(type) {
+	case SegmentKey:
+		if v != "" {
+			return []string{string(v)}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", nil

+	case Segments:
+		if len(v.Keys) == 1 && v.Keys[0] != "" {
+			return v.Keys, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR", nil
+		}
+		if len(v.Keys) > 1 && (v.SegmentOperator == "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR" || v.SegmentOperator == "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR") {
+			for _, key := range v.Keys {
+				if key == "" {
+					return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("empty segment key")
+				}
+			}
+			return v.Keys, v.SegmentOperator, nil
+		}
+	}
+	return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid rule segment: expected a key or keys with operator")
+}

+	for _, decode := range []struct {
+		name      string
+		unmarshal func([]byte, interface{}) error
+	}{
+		{"yaml.v2", yamlv2.Unmarshal},
+		{"yaml.v3", yamlv3.Unmarshal},
+	} {
+		t.Run(decode.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			for _, tc := range []struct {
+				input    string
+				keys     []string
+				operator string
+			}{
+				{"segment: foo", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+				{"segment: {keys: [foo], operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR}", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+				{"segment: {keys: [foo], operator: 99}", []string{"foo"}, "OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+				{"segment: {keys: [foo, bar], operator: AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR}", []string{"foo", "bar"}, "AND_SEGMENT_OPERATOR"},
+			} {
+				var rule Rule
+				require.NoError(t, decode.unmarshal([]byte(tc.input), &rule))
+				keys, operator, err := rule.Segment.KeysAndOperator()
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Equal(t, tc.keys, keys)
+				require.Equal(t, tc.operator, operator)
+				out, err := yamlv2.Marshal(&rule)
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				var roundtrip Rule

+				keys, operator, err = roundtrip.Segment.KeysAndOperator()
+				require.NoError(t, err)
+				require.Equal(t, tc.keys, keys)
+				require.Equal(t, tc.operator, operator)
+			}
+			for _, input := range []string{
+				"segment: []", "segment: {}", "segment: {keys: []}",
+				"segment: {keys: [foo, bar]}", "segment: {keys: [foo, bar], operator: BAD}",
+				"segment: {keys: [foo], extra: value}", "segment: {keys: [1]}",
+			} {
+				var rule Rule
+				require.Error(t, decode.unmarshal([]byte(input), &rule), input)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
